context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on strategy
purpose: Teach: 原案/本業/都度/縛ら/検事/集客/文言/網羅

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 戦略は、本業との接続点を網羅しておけ。
lines.en: Strategy — cover every intersection with your core business.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Sits with quiet certainty. Each phrase lands with weight. No rush. The voice of someone used to being listened to without performing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。原案を毎回都度精査しています。
lines.en: Understood. I review the draft carefully each time.
lines.style: Respectful but not servile. Clear and slightly formal. Sits forward slightly in posture. Shows he's taking the guidance seriously without being defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 文言一つで集客は揺れる。元検事の助言、活用しろ。
lines.en: A single phrase can shift how customers respond. Use that ex-prosecutor's counsel — it's worth it.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly on 'single phrase'. Conversational but pointed. No condescension. The tone of someone offering hard-won perspective, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。固定観念に縛られず、柔軟性も持ちます。
lines.en: Yes. I won't cling to fixed ideas — I'll stay flexible.
lines.style: Steady commitment in the voice. Nod quality to the delivery. Not defensive, genuinely agreeing. A promise underneath the words, quietly made.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Final word. Quiet approval. The brevity is the point — economy of praise. Slight downward inflection. Dismisses gently, trusts the work will continue.
